en.t: The lights became a kind of three-dimensional object.

units.source_text: 散落在平面四处的灯，失去了远近的感觉，

en.t: The lights scattered across the flat surface lost all sense of distance and perspective,

units.source_text: 恍如一座净是灯火构成的透明的大建筑物，长出复杂的角，拓展其翼楼，耸然屹立在深夜里。

en.t: as if a great transparent building made entirely of lights had grown intricate corners, spread out its wings, and stood towering in the depths of night.

units.source_text: 这真正称得上是京城附。

en.t: This could truly be called the outskirts of the capital.

units.source_text: 谁有皇宜的森林里缺少灯火，活像一个巨大的黑洞。

en.t: Only in the forest of the Imperial Palace were lights scarce, making it look just like a huge black hole.
